evidence: The plan sets canvas/fps correctly ("Canvas: 1080×1920 px (9:16), sRGB." and "Frame rate: 30 fps") and a 10-second Reel, but instead of per-text-block x/y or pixel-bound placement it only gives a single global margin that violates the required safe zone: "Safe margins: 220px top / 320px bottom to clear the Reels UI overlay" places text as high as y=220 (below the required top ≥ 250px floor) and as low as y=1600 (above the required bottom ≤ 1500px ceiling).
